title: Self-contained coefficient/exponent pair (2, 1) for MOD3 by gate elimination

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total MOD3 family defined in proof.md Section 1: L = {x in {0,1}^* : the number of ones in x is divisible by 3}; f_n(x)=1 iff |x|_1 = 0 (mod 3) for every integer n>=0 (f_0=1). It is decided at every length by one fixed linear-time counter-mod-3 evaluator, and V(x,w)=1 iff w is empty and the evaluator accepts x, with witness bound W=0.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"2"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"2"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(f_n)>=2n-3 for every integer n>=2 in the full Li\u2013Yang B2 model (proved even for circuits with free constant source nodes), hence C_B2(f_n)>=2n-o(n) at every sufficiently large integer length n=|x|.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}

claims: Unscored lemma (proof.md Theorem 5.1): for every integer m>=2 and every a in {0,1,2}, every generalized B2 circuit, i.e. a B2 circuit additionally allowed free constant 0/1 source nodes, that computes M_a^m(x)=[x_1+...+x_m = a (mod 3)] on {0,1}^m has at least 2m-3 gates.
